pairings.nmcName: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Patna
pairings.evidence: AIIMS is the standard acronym for All India Institute of Medical Sciences; same city (Patna). NMC row is the AIIMS(New Delhi)-affiliated statutory autonomous institute. Distinct from IGIMS Patna (rule 4).

pairings.ourName: ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Bihta, Patna
pairings.nmcName: Employees State Insurance Corporation Medical College,Patna
pairings.evidence: ESIC expands exactly to Employees State Insurance Corporation. NMC row's city is Bihta, matching our name's 'Bihta, Patna'. Corroborated by BCECE UGMAC-2025 seat matrix row 'ESIC M.C.& H. BIHTA,PATNA'.

pairings.ourName: Jananayak Karpoori Thakur Medical College & Hospital, Madhepura (JKTMCH)
pairings.nmcName: Jannayak Karpoori Thakur Medical College & Hospital, Madhepura, Bihar
pairings.evidence: Same institution; 'Jananayak' vs 'Jannayak' is a transliteration variant of the same title. Same city (Madhepura) and same acronym JKTMCH.

pairings.ourName: RDJM Medical College & Hospital, Turki, Muzaffarpur
pairings.nmcName: Radha Devi Jageshwari Memorial Medical College and Hospital
pairings.evidence: RDJM expands to Radha Devi Jageshwari Memorial. NMC row's city is Muzaffarpur, matching 'Turki, Muzaffarpur' (Turki is the locality within Muzaffarpur district). NMC website rdjmmch.com encodes the same acronym.

pairings.ourName: Shri Narayan Medical Institute & Hospital, Saharsa
pairings.nmcName: Shree Narayan Medical Institute and Hospital
pairings.evidence: Same institution; 'Shri' vs 'Shree' is a spelling variant. NMC row's city is Saharsa, matching ours; NMC affiliation (Bhupendra Narayan Mandal University, Madhepura) is the Saharsa-region university.

pairings.ourName: Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences (IGIMS), Patna
pairings.nmcName: Indira Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences,Sheikhpura, Patna
pairings.evidence: Resolves the ambiguous pair: name matches exactly apart from the Sheikhpura locality qualifier (IGIMS's Patna campus is at Sheikhpura). The rival candidate AIIMS Patna is a different institution in the same city and is rejected under rule 4; it is separately paired to its own NMC row.
